name: arc-reveal
note: 07 Arc Reveal (references/packaging/07_arc_reveal.png): 100 mm cube, lift-off lid with a semicircular arch cut at the foot of each side, base with flush arch panels that fill the cuts when closed. Lid body above the arch apex = 66 % of the height, base rim = 35 %. Black leather outside; grey leather accent on the arch panels and the whole lining (compartment, lid inside, insert, cushion).

materials.note: glTF-safe stock for the GLB: plain colour + leather039 grain (normal, roughness) at 1K. Renders swap in library leather via config/presets/box_arc_reveal_look.json.

scene.note: House values from config/studio_private_reference.json; world black like the floating tier scenes.
